events.title: NZ Dollar Falls As RBNZ Holds Key Rate Defying Market Expectation
events.description: The New Zealand dollar weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Wednesday, as the Reserve Bank of New Zealand or the RBNZ unexpected interest rate weighed on the currency.

events.title: GE HealthCare Shares Rise 7% On Higher Q3 Results, FY26 Outlook Upgrade
events.description: Shares of GE HealthCare Technologies Inc. were gaining around 7 percent in the morning trading on Nasdaq after the company on Wednesday reported higher third-quarter results and lifted fiscal 2026 outlook. The Company also announced that Jeannette Bankes, President and CEO, Patient Care Solutions, will be leaving for a CEO role at another firm.

events.title: Bank Of Canada Raises Rates By Quarter Point Amid Rising Cost Pressures
events.description: After leaving interest rates unchanged for seven consecutive meetings, the Bank of Canada on Wednesday announced its widely expected decision to raise rates by a quarter point. The Bank of Canada said it decided to increase its target for the overnight rate by 25 basis points to 2.5 percent, with the Bank Rate at 2.75 percent and the deposit rate at 2.45 percent.

events.title: Bay Street May Open With Negative Bias; BoC, Fed Policy Moves In Focus
events.description: Canadian stocks may open with a negative bias on Wednesday amid speculation the Bank of Canada will likely hike interest rate by 25 basis points. The Federal Reserve, which is also scheduled to announce its policy today, is widely expected to hold interest rate.

events.title: FTSE 100 Modestly Lower As Investors React To Earnings
events.description: The U.K. stock market's benchmark index FTSE 100 was down in negative territory around noon on Wednesday as investors digested quarterly earnings announcements from some big-name companies and looked ahead to the Federal Reserve's monetary policy announcement later in the day.

events.title: Indian Shares End Lower As IT Stocks Drag On Global AI Chip Rally
events.description: Indian shares closed lower on Wednesday as information technology stocks slumped amid renewed optimism surrounding artificial intelligence in global markets.

events.title: Deutsche Bank Shares Gain On Higher Q3 Results, Positive Outlook
events.description: Shares of Deutsche Bank AG were gaining around 3 percent in the morning trading in Germany and in pre-market activity on the NYSE, after the German lender reported Wednesday higher third-quarter profit with increased revenues and assets under management. Further, the firm confirmed fiscal 2026 outlook.

events.title: CAC 40 Roughly Flat Amid Mixed Earnings Updates
events.description: France's equity benchmark CAC 40 was roughly flat a little past noon on Wednesday as investors reacted to a mixed batch of corporate earnings and looked ahead to the monetary policy announcements from the Federal Reserve, due later in the day, and the European Central Bank's rate decision on Thursday.

events.title: Gold Edges Lower Ahead Of Fed Decision
events.description: Gold prices were subdued on Wednesday as oil prices moved back toward four-year highs and caution prevailed ahead of the Federal Reserve's interest-rate decision later in the day.

events.title: DAX Down Slightly At Noon; Symrise Tanks, Deutsche Bank Rises On Results
events.description: German stocks turned in a mixed performance on Wednesday with investors reacting to corporate earnings updates and awaiting the Federal Reserve's monetary policy announcement later in the day, as well the European Central Bank's policy decision on Thursday.

events.title: Oil Prices Climb After Attack On Saudi Arabian Refinery
events.description: Oil prices moved back toward four-year highs on Wednesday as investors monitored election results in Israel and assessed the chances of U.S. resuming military strikes on Iran.

events.title: European Shares Subdued Ahead Of UK Budget, Fed Verdict
events.description: European stocks were subdued on Wednesday as traders awaited the 2026 U.K. autumn budget, earnings from big tech companies and the U.S. Federal Reserve's interest-rate decision.

events.title: German Consumers Remain Pessimistic On Inflation Fears
events.description: German consumer confidence is set to weaken in November due to rising inflation concerns and subdued income prospects, survey data from the Nuremberg Institute for Market Decisions and the GfK market research institute showed Wednesday. The forward-looking consumer climate index fell slightly to -30.8 in November from -30.6 in October. The reading was expected to improve to -30.1.
